decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=/sensor/temp, kind=RESULT, VALUE u32=1234, PATH_REF{ index=2, generation=0 } } — the answer to fwd/fwd-mint-request: the ordinary reply plus the minted binding as its LAST child.
decoded.note: RFC-0024 §7.5. 4 + 8 bytes on the reply and none on the request. LAST, so a positional reader of an ordinary reply (op / dst / src / kind / payload) is untouched and only an origin that asked reads past.
